scope.age_claim: provisional ages-3-to-5 developmental calibration; never infant calibration

engine.name: Blender
engine.selection_reason: TDW dependency repair succeeded but repeated native and Rosetta controller runs stalled after handshake before ProcGenScene returned; Blender passed the physical measurement contract without learner outcomes

physical_measurement_contract.contact: exact signed distance on evaluated oriented primitive collision geometry
physical_measurement_contract.joint: position and velocity from evaluated relative transforms; never motor targets
physical_measurement_contract.imu: central finite differences of evaluated pose with one-sided boundaries and no smoothing
physical_measurement_contract.action: timestamped command ledger distinct from measured proprioception

calibration_freeze.participant_disjoint_policy: fit on two frozen six-participant folds and assess on the third, rotated across all three folds
calibration_freeze.tuning_budget: maximum 24 generator configurations selected only from calibration folds
calibration_freeze.loss: equal-weight normalized Wasserstein distance over comparable output distributions plus absolute dependence errors
calibration_freeze.validator_inputs: decoded MP4/WAV and emitted event streams only; generator target fields forbidden
calibration_freeze.readiness_controls: anti-leakage, official learner smoke, held-out oracle, destroyed mapping

stop_condition.reason: The retained public summary pools all 18 development participants, while the restricted fold-level feature material was intentionally removed after the clean V5 run. It is impossible to tune and independently assess the generator without either restoring the frozen restricted material or reacquiring the exact bounded development selection.
